title: Abbas Nahi Hai
body:
Kya Alam-e-Tanhaye Hai Farzand-e-Nabi Par
Abbas Nahi Hai – Abbas Nahi Hai
Lo Qatm Huwa Dasht Me Shabbir Ka Lashkar
Besheer Ke Hulkum Par Ab Teer Chalega
<<DIVIDER>>
Marjayega Pyasa
Pherega Ussi Halq Pa Qanjar Bhi Sitamgar
Wo Sar Jo Kabhi Zeenat-e-Aghosh-e-Nabi Tha
Ab Waqt Ye Aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kat Jayega Ab Shirm Ke Kahnjar Se Wohi Sar
Har Simt Bhadak Outhenge Ab Agg Ke Shoule
Jal Jayenge Qaime
Chin Jayega Ab Abid-e-Bimar Ka Bistar
<<DIVIDER>>
Royegi Sakina Tho Naye Zulm Ye Honge
Khayegi Tamache
Chinega Gouhar Kaano Se Ab Shimr Sitamgar
Ab Abid-e-Bimar Pa Tootegi Qayamat
<<DIVIDER>>
Duroun Ki Aziyat
Jakdenge Ounhe Touq-o-salasil Me Sitamgar
Ban-jayenge Saidanioun Ke Bazu Rasan Me
Abbas Ke Bahene
<<DIVIDER>>
Daabaro Me Barzaro Me Jayenge Khule Sar
Qaime Me Har Ek Simth Faqath Aaho-Bukha Hai
Ek Harsh Bapa Hai
Sab Ahle Haram Rote Hai Ahsan Yehi Khekar
